query.q: sum(rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{environment=~"#{environment}",environment!="", cluster=~"#{cluster}",cluster!="", service=~"#{service}",service!="", instance=~"#{instance}",instance!="", datname=~"#{datname}",datname!=""}[5m])) / (sum(rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{environment=~"#{environment}",environment!="", cluster=~"#{cluster}",cluster!="", service=~"#{service}",service!="", instance=~"#{instance}",instance!="", datname=~"#{datname}",datname!=""}[5m])) + sum(rate(pg_stat_database_blks_read{environment=~"#{environment}",environment!="", cluster=~"#{cluster}",cluster!="", service=~"#{service}",service!="", instance=~"#{instance}",instance!="", datname=~"#{datname}",datname!=""}[5m]))) * 100
